v.t: Ya, Seen
v.l: Ya -Sin

v.t: By the Wise Quran
v.l: Wa Al-Qur'ani Al-Hakimi

v.t: You are one of the messengers
v.l: Innaka Lamina Al-Mursalina

v.t: On a straight path
v.l: Ala Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: The revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful
v.l: Tanzila Al-`Azizi Ar-Rahimi

v.t: To warn a people whose ancestors were not warned, and so they are unaware
v.l: Litundhira Qawmaan Ma 'Undhira 'Aba'uuhum Fahum Ghafiluna

v.t: The Word was realized against most of them, for they do not believe
v.l: Laqad Haqqa Al-Qawlu `Ala 'Aktharihim Fahum La Yu'uminuna

v.t: We placed shackles around their necks, up to their chins, so they are stiff-necked
v.l: Inna Ja`alna Fi 'A`naqihim 'Aghlalaan Fahiya 'Ila Al-'Adhqani Fahum Muqmahuna

v.t: And We placed a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them, so they cannot see
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Min Bayni 'Aydihim Saddaan Wa Min Khalfihim Saddaan Fa'aghshaynahum Fahum La Yubsiruna

v.t: It is the same for them, whether you warn them, or do not warn them—they will not believe
v.l: Wa Sawa'un `Alayhim 'A'andhartahum 'Am Lam Tundhirhum La Yu'uminuna

v.t: You warn only him who follows the Message, and fears the Most Gracious inwardly. So give him good news of forgiveness, and a generous reward
v.l: Innama Tundhiru Mani Attaba`a Adh-Dhikra Wa Khashiya Ar-Rahmana Bil-Ghaybi Fabashirhu Bimaghfiratin Wa 'Ajrin Karimin

v.t: It is We who revive the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded, and their traces. We have tallied all things in a Clear Record
v.l: Inna Nahnu Nuhyi Al-Mawta Wa Naktubu Ma Qaddamu Wa 'Atharahum Wa Kulla Shay'in 'Hsaynahu Fi 'Imamin Mubinin

v.t: And cite for them the parable of the landlords of the town—when the messengers came to it
v.l: Wa Ađrib Lahum Mathalaan 'Ashaba Al-Qaryati 'Idh Ja'aha Al-Mursaluna

v.t: We sent them two messengers, but they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third. They said, “We are messengers to you.”
v.l: Idh 'Arsalna 'Ilayhimu Athnayni Fakadhabuhuma Fa`azzazna Bithalithin Faqalu 'Inna 'Ilaykum Mursaluna
w: but they denied both of them

v.t: They said, “You are nothing but humans like us, and the Gracious did not send down anything; you are only lying.”
v.l: Qalu Ma 'Antum 'Illa Basharun Mithluna Wa Ma 'Anzala Ar-Rahmanu Min Shay'in 'In 'Antum 'Illa Takdhibuna

v.t: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you
v.l: Qalu Rabbuna Ya`lamu 'Inna 'Ilaykum Lamursaluna

v.t: And our only duty is clear communication.”
v.l: Wa Ma `Alayna 'Illa Al-Balaghu Al-Mubinu

v.t: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.”
v.l: Qalu 'Inna Tatayyarna Bikum La'in Lam Tantahu Lanarjumannakum Wa Layamassannakum Minna `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: They said, “Your evil omen is upon you. Is it because you were reminded? But you are an extravagant people.”
v.l: Qalu Ta'irukum Ma`akum 'A'in Dhukkirtum Bal 'Antum Qawmun Musrifuna

v.t: Then a man came running from the remotest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers
v.l: Wa Ja'a Min 'Aqsa Al-Madinati Rajulun Yas`a Qala Ya Qawmi Attabi`u Al-Mursalina

v.t: Follow those who ask you of no wage, and are themselves guided
v.l: Attabi`u Man La Yas'alukum 'Ajraan Wa Hum Muhtaduna

v.t: “And why should I not worship Him Who created me, and to Whom you will be returned
v.l: Wa Ma Liya La 'A`budu Al-Ladhi Fatarani Wa 'Ilayhi Turja`una

v.t: Shall I take other gods instead of Him? If the Merciful desires harm for me, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor will they save me
v.l: A'attakhidhu Min Dunihi 'Alihatan 'In Yuridni Ar-Rahmanu Biđurrin La Tughni `Anni Shafa`atuhum Shay'aan Wa La Yunqidhuni

v.t: In that case, I would be completely lost
v.l: Inni 'Idhaan Lafi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”
v.l: Inni 'Amantu Birabbikum Fasma`uni

v.t: It was said, “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew
v.l: Qila Adkhuli Al-Jannata Qala Ya Layta Qawmi Ya`lamuna

v.t: How my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honored.”
v.l: Bima Ghafara Li Rabbi Wa Ja`alani Mina Al-Mukramina

v.t: After him, We sent down no hosts from heaven to his people; nor would We ever send any down
v.l: Wa Ma 'Anzalna `Ala Qawmihi Min Ba`dihi Min Jundin Mina As-Sama'i Wa Ma Kunna Munzilina

v.t: It was just one Cry, and they were stilled
v.l: In Kanat 'Illa Sayhatan Wahidatan Fa'idha Hum Khamiduna

v.t: Alas for the servants. No messenger ever came to them, but they ridiculed him
v.l: Ya Hasratan `Ala Al-`Ibadi Ma Ya'tihim Min Rasulin 'Illa Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them; and that unto them they will not return
v.l: Alam Yaraw Kam 'Ahlakna Qablahum Mina Al-Quruni 'Annahum 'Ilayhim La Yarji`una

v.t: All of them, every single one of them, will be arraigned before Us
v.l: Wa 'In Kullun Lamma Jami`un Ladayna Muhđaruna

v.t: And there is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life, and produce from it grains from which they eat
v.l: Wa 'Ayatun Lahumu Al-'Arđu Al-Maytatu 'Ahyaynaha Wa 'Akhrajna Minha Habbaan Faminhu Ya'kuluna

v.t: And We place in it gardens of palm-trees and vines, and cause springs to gush out of it
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Fiha Jannatin Min Nakhilin Wa 'A`nabin Wa Fajjarna Fiha Mina Al-`Uyuni
w: and We caused to gush forth

v.t: That they may eat from its fruits, although their hands did not make it. Will they not be appreciative
v.l: Liya'kulu Min Thamarihi Wa Ma `Amilat/hu 'Aydihim 'Afala Yashkuruna

v.t: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs; of what the earth produces, and of their own selves, and of what they do not know
v.l: Subhana Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Al-'Azwaja Kullaha Mimma Tunbitu Al-'Arđu Wa Min 'Anfusihim Wa Mimma La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Another sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are in darkness
v.l: Wa 'Ayatun Lahumu Al-Laylu Naslakhu Minhu An-Nahara Fa'idha Hum Muzlimuna

v.t: And the sun runs towards its destination. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing
v.l: Wa Ash-Shamsu Tajri Limustaqarrin Laha Dhalika Taqdiru Al-`Azizi Al-`Alimi

v.t: And the moon: We have disposed it in phases, until it returns like the old twig
v.l: Wa Al-Qamara Qaddarnahu Manazila Hatta `Ada Kal`urjuni Al-Qadimi

v.t: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day. Each floats in an orbit
v.l: La Ash-Shamsu Yanbaghi Laha 'An Tudrika Al-Qamara Wa La Al-Laylu Sabiqu An-Nahari Wa Kullun Fi Falakin Yasbahuna

v.t: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark
v.l: Wa 'Ayatun Lahum 'Anna Hamalna Dhurriyatahum Fi Al-Fulki Al-Mashhuni

v.t: And We created for them the like of it, in which they ride
v.l: Wa Khalaqna Lahum Min Mithlihi Ma Yarkabuna

v.t: If We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be saved
v.l: Wa 'In Nasha' Nughriqhum Fala Sarikha Lahum Wa La Hum Yunqadhuna
w: (would be) a responder to a cry

v.t: Except by a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while
v.l: Illa Rahmatan Minna Wa Mata`aan 'Ila Hinin

v.t: Yet when it is said to them, “Beware of what lies before you, and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahumu Attaqu Ma Bayna 'Aydikum Wa Ma Khalfakum La`allakum Turhamuna

v.t: Yet never came to them a sign of their Lord’s signs, but they turned away from it
v.l: Wa Ma Ta'tihim Min 'Ayatin Min 'Ayati Rabbihim 'Illa Kanu `Anha Mu`riđina

v.t: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what God has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Shall we feed someone whom God could feed, if He so willed? You must be deeply misguided.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahum 'Anfiqu Mimma Razaqakumu Allahu Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lilladhina 'Amanu 'Anut`imu Man Law Yasha'u Allahu 'At`amahu 'In 'Antum 'Illa Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: And they say, “When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Wa`du 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: All they can expect is a single blast, which will seize them while they feud
v.l: Ma Yanzuruna 'Illa Sayhatan Wahidatan Ta'khudhuhum Wa Hum Yakhissimuna

v.t: They will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families
v.l: Fala Yastati`una Tawsiyatan Wa La 'Ila 'Ahlihim Yarji`una

v.t: The Trumpet will be blown, then behold, they will rush from the tombs to their Lord
v.l: Wa Nufikha Fi As-Suri Fa'idha Hum Mina Al-'Ajdathi 'Ila Rabbihim Yansiluna

v.t: They will say, “Woe to us! Who resurrected us from our resting-place?” This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the messengers have spoken the truth.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Waylana Man Ba`athana Min Marqadina Hadha Ma Wa`ada Ar-Rahmanu Wa Sadaqa Al-Mursaluna

v.t: It will be but a single scream; and behold, they will all be brought before Us
v.l: In Kanat 'Illa Sayhatan Wahidatan Fa'idha Hum Jami`un Ladayna Muhđaruna

v.t: On that Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will be recompensed only for what you used to do
v.l: Falyawma La Tuzlamu Nafsun Shay'aan Wa La Tujzawna 'Illa Ma Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: The inhabitants of Paradise, on that Day, will be happily busy
v.l: Inna 'Ashaba Al-Jannati Al-Yawma Fi Shughulin Fakihuna

v.t: They and their spouses, in shades, reclining on couches
v.l: Hum Wa 'Azwajuhum Fi Zilalin `Ala Al-'Ara'iki Muttaki'una

v.t: They will have therein fruits. They will have whatever they call for
v.l: Lahum Fiha Fakihatun Wa Lahum Ma Yadda`una

v.t: Peace—a saying from a Most Merciful Lord
v.l: Salamun Qawlaan Min Rabbin Rahimin

v.t: But step aside today, you criminals
v.l: Wa Amtazu Al-Yawma 'Ayyuha Al-Mujrimuna

v.t: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not serve the devil? That he is your sworn enemy
v.l: Alam 'A`had 'Ilaykum Ya Bani 'Adama 'An La Ta`budu Ash-Shaytana 'Innahu Lakum `Aduwun Mubinun

v.t: And that you shall serve Me? This is a straight path
v.l: Wa 'Ani A`buduni Hadha Siratun Mustaqimun

v.t: He has misled a great multitude of you. Did you not understand
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Ađalla Minkum Jibillaan Kathiraan 'Afalam Takunu Ta`qiluna

v.t: This is Hellfire, which you were promised
v.l: Hadhihi Jahannamu Allati Kuntum Tu`aduna

v.t: Roast in it today, because you persistently disbelieved
v.l: Aslawha Al-Yawma Bima Kuntum Takfuruna

v.t: On this Day, We will seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to everything they had done
v.l: Al-Yawma Nakhtimu `Ala 'Afwahihim Wa Tukallimuna 'Aydihim Wa Tash/hadu 'Arjuluhum Bima Kanu Yaksibuna

v.t: If We will, We can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path—but how will they see
v.l: Wa Law Nasha'u Latamasna `Ala 'A`yunihim Fastabaqu As-Sirata Fa'anna Yubsiruna

v.t: And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back
v.l: Wa Law Nasha'u Lamasakhnahum `Ala Makanatihim Fama Astata`u Muđiyaan Wa La Yarji`una

v.t: Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand
v.l: Wa Man Nu`ammirhu Nunakkis/hu Fi Al-Khalqi 'Afala Ya`qiluna

v.t: We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran
v.l: Wa Ma `Allamnahu Ash-Shi`ra Wa Ma Yanbaghi Lahu 'In Huwa 'Illa Dhikrun Wa Qur'anun Mubinun

v.t: That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless
v.l: Liyundhira Man Kana Hayyaan Wa Yahiqqa Al-Qawlu `Ala Al-Kafirina

v.t: Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock that they own
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Anna Khalaqna Lahum Mimma `Amilat 'Aydina 'An`amaan Fahum Laha Malikuna

v.t: And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat
v.l: Wa Dhallalnaha Lahum Faminha Rakubuhum Wa Minha Ya'kuluna

v.t: And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks
v.l: Wa Lahum Fiha Manafi`u Wa Masharibu 'Afala Yashkuruna

v.t: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than God, that perhaps they may be helped
v.l: Wa Attakhadhu Min Duni Allahi 'Alihatan La`allahum Yunsaruna

v.t: They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them
v.l: La Yastati`una Nasrahum Wa Hum Lahum Jundun Muhđaruna

v.t: So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal
v.l: Fala Yahzunka Qawluhum 'Inna Na`lamu Ma Yusirruna Wa Ma Yu`linuna

v.t: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary
v.l: Awalam Yara Al-'Insanu 'Anna Khalaqnahu Min Nutfatin Fa'idha Huwa Khasimun Mubinun

v.t: And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, “Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?”
v.l: Wa Đaraba Lana Mathalaan Wa Nasiya Khalqahu Qala Man Yuhyi Al-`Izama Wa Hiya Ramimun

v.t: Say, “He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation.”
v.l: Qul Yuhyiha Al-Ladhi 'Ansha'aha 'Awwala Marratin Wa Huwa Bikulli Khalqin `Alimun

v.t: He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire
v.l: Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakum Mina Ash-Shajari Al-'Akhđari Naraan Fa'idha 'Antum Minhu Tuqiduna

v.t: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator
v.l: Awalaysa Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Biqadirin `Ala 'An Yakhluqa Mithlahum Bala Wa Huwa Al-Khallaqu Al-`Alimu

v.t: His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be
v.l: Innama 'Amruhu 'Idha 'Arada Shay'aan 'An Yaqula Lahu Kun Fayakunu

v.t: So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned
v.l: Fasubhana Al-Ladhi Biyadihi Malakutu Kulli Shay'in Wa 'Ilayhi Turja`una
